description:
Performance-only lookup for a single position by `(market-id, user-address)`.

Returns performance analytics inside a `data` envelope. `effective_rate_wad` is compounded IRR+ using a 365.25-day year; `effective_apr` is simple interest using a 365-day year and is capped at `10` (1000%). The position detail endpoint omits these fields to keep state and performance concerns separate. When the position is closed or has never existed for a known market, this endpoint returns `type: null` and null analytics.

user-address.description: User address for the requested position. Lowercase input is checksummed.

name: morpho_midnight_get_user_position_performance

data.description: Position performance payload. Positions with zero balances are returned with null type and null analytics.

accounting_method.description: Accounting method used to compute cost basis.

chain_id.description: Chain id where the position exists.

cost_basis.description: Cost basis in loan-token units, WAD-scaled, when available.

effective_apr.description: Annualized simple effective rate using a 365-day year, as a decimal fraction capped at 10, derived from persisted open lots when available.

effective_rate_wad.description: Annualized compounded effective rate (IRR+) using a 365.25-day year, WAD-scaled, when available.

last_indexed_block.description: Latest block covered by the API when this position payload was computed.

type.description: Position type, or null when the position has zero credit, zero debt, and no remaining collateral.
